title: Ferrovial announces commercial close of I-24 Southeast Choice Lanes in Tennessee
summary: Sala de prensa Ferrovial | Últimas noticias
body_markdown:
Ferrovial, a leading global infrastructure company, announces that **commercial close** has been reached with the **Tennessee Department of Transportation (TDOT)** for the **I-24 Southeast Choice Lanes in Nashville** . This milestone establishes the contractual framework for **one of Tennessee’s most transformative transportation initiatives** , marking the state’s largest single capital investment and **first public-private partnership** in its history.


Under the agreement, the **Ferrovial-led DriveTN consortium** will **finance, design, build, operate and maintain the lanes under a 50-year concession** that will begin once open to traffic. In August 2026, TDOT selected the DriveTN consortium, of which Transurban and Tikehau Star Infra are also part, to deliver the project.


The I-24 Southeast Choice Lanes project will add **new lanes in both directions along a 26-mile stretch of I-24** between Nashville and Murfreesboro. The choice lanes are designed to provide **more reliable travel times** , even during peak periods, while helping improve traffic flow in the general-purpose lanes.


Beyond improving mobility, the project is expected to **drive economic growth** , **create jobs and opportunities for local businesses, strengthen local communities** , and deliver lasting value that supports the region’s continued success.
